description:
AthleteOS is a calm, personal performance system for student athletes: training built around your real schedule, plus the knowledge and mindset to get better.

HOME: YOUR DAY IN ONE SCREEN
• A two-tap morning check-in. With Apple Watch or a band that writes to Apple Health, sleep and energy are filled in for you
• Today's readiness in words, today's training, and why the plan looks the way it does
• Sick, travelling, on holiday or had a head knock? One tap and the plan backs off

TRAINING THAT FITS YOUR DAY
• After practice: short strength and injury prevention. Gym day: the full session on days without practice
• Movement prep that changes with the day: a quick wake-up before practice, a calm wind-down in the evening
• Set your training experience: new lifters start with less, experienced lifters get more
• Pick your gym days and swap any exercise; with Pro, change every set and rep and build your own workouts

BUILT AROUND YOUR SCHEDULE
• Connect your team or school calendar: games, practices and exams come in by themselves
• A cancelled practice turns into a gym day; exam weeks get lighter training
• 60 sports with their formats and positions

GET BETTER AT YOUR SPORT
• 850+ exercises and drills with animated how-tos
• Tests every 6–8 weeks: jump, sprints, plank, push-ups and a test for your sport
• Know your sport: a researched guide for 29 sports, with the studies behind it

CAMPUS: LEARN IN A FEW MINUTES A DAY
• Short lessons on training, nutrition, sleep, injuries, psychology, tactics and more: a hook, the idea, an athlete's example, and what it means for you
• XP, streaks, badges and spaced review; leagues with your teammates

MINDSET
• A 2-minute evening reflection, season goals, guided breathing and a game-day visualization (Pro)

TEAM & FAMILY
• Coach mode: your team's readiness at a glance
• A private weekly summary link for parents, numbers only

SAFETY FIRST
• Head knock? Training pauses and the return-to-play steps are explained; your doctor decides
• Fuel, don't diet: no calorie counting, no weight-loss goals

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Use it without an account, or sign in with Apple to back up and join teams. No ads, no tracking

ATHLETEOS PRO
Free: the check-in, your plan and every kind of workout, logging, the Watch app, safety, daily lessons, guides, leagues and teams. Pro (monthly or yearly) adds the workout editor, unlimited lessons, full history and charts, the season calendar and more. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage them in your App Store account settings.

AthleteOS gives general training information for athletes 13 and up. It is not medical advice, never predicts injury, never clears anyone to return to play, and never replaces a coach, athletic trainer or doctor.

notes:
WHAT THE APP IS
AthleteOS is a training companion for high school and college athletes (13+). It builds workouts around the athlete's sport, season, practices, games and exams, adjusts each day from a morning check-in, and adds learning (Campus lessons) and mindset tools. All plan logic runs on-device with deterministic algorithms; there is no AI/LLM, no ads and no third-party SDKs.

SIGN IN
No account needed: after the birth date, tap "Continue without an account" — everything works on the device. Sign in with Apple (any Apple ID, no demo account needed) adds backup, teams, leagues, the parent link and sharing; guests can sign in later in Me → Account. Paywall: Me → Subscription, or any locked item (e.g. Progress → Year). Pro: $2.99/month (intro $0.99/month for 3 months) or $24.99/year, shown in local currency via StoreKit.

HOW TO REVIEW IN FIVE MINUTES
1. Enter any birth date 13+ years ago, sign in with Apple, pick a sport (e.g. Soccer) and a position.
2. Home: do the morning check-in, set practice days, open today's workout and tap Start. Movement prep changes before practice vs. the evening.
3. Campus tab: play a lesson, then the trophy (leagues) and medal (badges). Workout → "Know your sport" for the sport guide.
4. Home → Your levels → Mindset: evening reflection, season goals, breathing.
5. Me → Tests (jump test uses the camera), Team & family, Head knocks & concussion, Log out and Delete account.

AGE (1.3 / 5.1.1)
A date-of-birth gate blocks anyone under 13. We store the Apple user identifier ("sub") and birth date; no email, location or contacts. An optional first name (only for the greeting) stays on the device and is never uploaded.

HEALTH DATA (5.1.3)
With permission the app reads sleep, workouts, resting heart rate and heart-rate variability from Apple Health to pre-fill the check-in, and writes finished sessions as workouts. Health data is used only for the user's own training in the app — never for advertising, never shared or sold. Everything works if permission is declined.

CAMERA
Used only for the vertical jump test: the video stays on the device and is used to measure flight time.

TEST CODES (no second account needed)
• Team DTCQYE: Me → My team (sign in first)
• League H59BPQ: Campus → trophy → Join (sign in first)
• Shared workout FGGAGC: Workout → My workouts → Add with a code
Codes also work as links (https://api.lejacob.dev/fitness/team/DTCQYE) and QR codes.

USER CONTENT (1.2)
Private groups joined by code; no chat. Others can see nicknames, league/team/workout names and a coach's short workout notes — all filtered for objectionable words on the server. Report: long-press a league name, or Report on teams and shared workouts; block league members. Reports reviewed within 24 h; a workout reported by 3 people is unshared automatically. Terms include zero-tolerance community rules. Contact form: https://api.lejacob.dev/fitness/support. The parent summary is a private, revocable numbers-only link.

NO MEDICAL CLAIMS (1.4.1)
The app never predicts injury or diagnoses. The concussion page explains the standard graduated return-to-sport steps (2023 international consensus, CDC HEADS UP) and pauses training; it states that a doctor must clear the athlete. The low-energy notice suggests eating enough and talking to a parent, coach or doctor. Fuelling guidance never includes a calorie deficit.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
AthleteOS Pro (monthly / yearly, one group). Always free: check-in, plan and all workouts, logging, Campus (3 lessons a day), guides, leagues, teams, the Watch app, log out and deletion.

ACCOUNT DELETION
Me → Delete account deletes the account and all server data (revoking the Sign in with Apple token via Apple's REST API), then clears the device. Guests: Me → Delete all my data.
